variables.name: Sahel monthly rainfall
variables.source: NASA POWER Version 10.0.0 / MERRA-2 bias-corrected precipitation reanalysis; monthly amounts derived from PRECTOTCORR.
variables.scientific_name: Monthly precipitation amount derived from PRECTOTCORR
limitations: NASA POWER / MERRA-2 bias-corrected reanalysis, not direct station observations or satellite-only rainfall.
Monthly amounts equal source mean daily rate times actual Gregorian month length; source rounding retained.
Western Sahel subset only: no land mask; not the whole Sahel.
This subset did not show statistically supported opposing trends.
Monthly-amount trend and annual-total grid trends have different aggregation semantics.
variables.spatial_support: Western Sahel native grid: 99 cell centres over 12-17 N, 5 W-0 E; 0.5 latitude by 0.625 longitude degrees. No land mask or interpolation; not a Pakistan city dataset.
